1.name: Generate course: a line appears, its font-size >= 16 px
1.text: Gates: 14. The start gate is 42 m away: follow the arrow. Key Shift+T hides the course

2.name: the ready line stays >= shownMs(text) - 200 ms
2.text: Gates: 14. The start gate is 42 m away: follow the arrow. Key Shift+T hides the course

3.name: progress in place: the progress box while building, one node under course.progress
sample: Gates: 14. The start gate is 42 m away: follow the arrow. Key Shift+T hides the course

4.name: a problem stays 20 s with a 44 px cross and a fix line; Esc, Messages, Send to the author opens the form with its text
4.text: This course did not come out. Shift+G builds another one
4.fix: If it comes again, send it to the author: the button below.

5.name: the top-row Messages button opens the list with 1 and 4; Shift+J toggles it; its cross and Esc close it

6.name: every message: inside the view, over no top-row button or OSD, outside the middle third

7.name: with the pause menu up, key Shift+J (named on its Messages item) opens the list at one press; Esc closes it

8.name: edit mode: three keys of the flight give one line saying what to press, no problem, gone by itself
8.said: P works in flight, not in the editor: press Esc to leave the editor, then P.
